researchResponse.query: For a research methods comparison, explain the difference between assigning GWAS loci to immune cell types using expression enrichment and using eQTL colocalization. Retrieve two relevant primary publications and include each title and DOI or PMID, with the specific claim it supports. Clearly identify any retrieval failure. researchResponse.answer: Assigning GWAS loci to immune cell types using **expression enrichment** evaluates whether the genes near GWAS variants are disproportionately highly expressed in a specific cell type compared to a background. It relies on aggregate gene expression levels to infer cell-type relevance. In contrast, **eQTL colocalization** determines whether the exact same genetic variants driving the GWAS trait are also driving the expression of a gene
